welcome.title: Welcome to Neeze
welcome.body: Find trusted local services, doctors and businesses in Silchar, and send them a request in a few taps.

home.servicesBody: Electricians, plumbers, mechanics and more, near you.

explore.title: Explore
explore.results: {count, plural, =0 {No results} one {# result} other {# results}}
explore.noResultsBody: Try a shorter word, another spelling, or a nearby area. We are adding new providers every week.

provider.notAccepting: Not accepting requests right now. Please call instead.
provider.verificationHelp: This label shows only what Neeze has checked. It is not a guarantee of work quality.

request.appointmentNote: This is a request, not a confirmed appointment. The clinic will call you to confirm.
request.describeHint: For example: ceiling fan not working in the bedroom
request.name: Your name
request.privacy: Your number is shared only with the provider you chose, so they can call you.
request.queued: You are offline. We saved your request and will send it when you are back online.
request.sentBody: Your request number is {code}. {name} will contact you. You can track it under Me.
request.error: Could not send. Please check the details and try again.

errors.too_soon: Please wait a minute before asking for another code.
errors.too_many: Too many codes requested. Try again in an hour.
errors.expired: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong tries. Ask for a new code.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

me.title: My account
me.noRequests: You have not sent any requests yet.

saved.title: Saved
saved.empty: Tap Save on any provider to keep their number here. Saved providers work offline.

emergency.title: Emergency numbers
emergency.body: These numbers stay available without internet once you have opened this page.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: This page is not saved on your phone yet. Your saved providers and emergency numbers still work.

pwa.install: Add Neeze to your home screen
pwa.installBody: Opens faster and works with weak signal.
pwa.iosHint: Tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
pwa.update: A new version of Neeze is ready.
